speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You have presented with gait and limb ataxia; to begin my investigation, how long have you been experiencing these coordination difficulties, and have they been progressive or sudden in onset?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms started "recently" and affect the right side more; were these coordination issues present in the past, or is this the very first time you have experienced them?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy)

I am deeply concerned you have been taking natalizumab for Crohn's disease; we need to confirm if this medication caused a serious brain infection given your new ataxia. Can you tell me if you have noticed any changes in your vision, such as blurred spots or double vision, or any recent cognitive slowing? REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain
